## Timestamp-indexed visual evidence — C63 / v3

Each tile has a small lower-left source label in the form “C63 / v3 / 32.00 seconds” (time changes per tile) and a dark bottom strip labelled with the corresponding time to three decimals, e.g. “32.000 seconds.” No player focus, ON AIR indicator, or speaker video tiles are visible.

- **32.000 seconds:** Brown background; “CAFE” at upper left. Centered stylized sailboat with cream hull and vertical mast, and a blue triangular sail to the left of the mast. Beneath it: “Find a new stroy in your city.”
- **34.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Cream sailboat hull and mast with blue triangular sail. Beneath: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Same visible composition as at 32 seconds.
- **36.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Centered dark navy rounded rectangle containing three left-aligned lines: “NIGHT / RESERVE”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”.
- **38.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Dark navy rounded rectangle with “NIGHT / RESERVE”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”, in the same placement as at 36 seconds.
- **40.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Dark navy rounded rectangle with “NIGHT / RESERVE”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”. Same visible panel layout as at 36 and 38 seconds.
- **42.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Centered cream sailboat hull and mast; triangular sail is now coral-red rather than blue. Beneath: “Find a new stroy in your city.”
- **44.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Cream sailboat with coral-red triangular sail. Beneath: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Same visible composition as at 42 seconds.
- **46.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Cream sailboat with coral-red triangular sail. Beneath: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Same visible composition as at 42 and 44 seconds.
- **48.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Across the center are three cream rectangular outlines, each enclosing a cream circular disk. To their right is a separate cream vertical stroke, followed by a rightmost partial rectangular outline containing a semicircular cream shape with a straight left edge.
- **50.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Three outlined cream rectangles with circular cream centers, followed by a separate vertical cream stroke and a partial rightmost outlined rectangle with a semicircular center. Same visible arrangement as at 48 seconds.
- **52.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” A broad cream arch joins two thick vertical cream supports. Above the arch are two dark navy circular indicators, labelled “L” on the left and “R” on the right; neither appears brightly illuminated. Inside/below the arch: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”. Along the bottom: “CALIBRATION / SECOND”.
- **54.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Cream arch and two vertical supports. Dark navy circular “L” and “R” indicators above its left and right sides, neither visibly bright. Text: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE” and, near the bottom, “CALIBRATION / SECOND”. Same visible arrangement as at 52 seconds.
- **56.000 seconds:** Brown background; upper-left “CAFE.” Cream arch between thick cream supports; dark navy “L” and “R” circular indicators above, neither visibly bright. “A NEW PERSPECTIVE” within the arch area; “CALIBRATION / SECOND” near the bottom. Same visible arrangement as at 52 and 54 seconds.
- **58.000 seconds:** Nearly black background with the white word “TAIL” near the center-left. No “CAFE”, arch, sailboat, or indicator circles visible. Source label reads “C63 / v3 / 58.00 seconds”; bottom strip reads “58.000 seconds.”
